entries.name: Vision rehabilitation
entries.definition: Training and therapy that help people with vision loss use their remaining sight and other abilities to manage everyday tasks.

entries.name: Visme
entries.definition: An online tool for making presentations, infographics and other visual content.

entries.name: VisSim
entries.definition: A visual block-diagram program for modelling and simulating dynamic systems.

entries.name: Visual impairment education
entries.definition: The specialist teaching of students who are blind or have low vision, adapting materials and methods to their needs.

entries.name: Visual odometry
entries.definition: A computer-vision technique that estimates how a camera or robot has moved by analysing a sequence of images.

entries.name: Visual storytelling
entries.definition: Telling a story or making a point mainly through images, video, layout and design rather than text.

entries.name: VMware Aria Automation
entries.definition: A VMware platform for automating the deployment and management of cloud infrastructure and applications, formerly called vRealize Automation.

entries.name: VMware Aria Automation Orchestrator
entries.definition: A VMware workflow automation engine that builds and runs automated workflows for IT tasks, formerly called vRealize Orchestrator.

entries.name: VMware Aria Operations
entries.definition: A VMware platform for monitoring the performance, capacity and health of IT infrastructure and applications, formerly called vRealize Operations.

entries.name: VMware Aria Operations for Logs
entries.definition: A VMware service for collecting, searching and analysing log data from IT systems, formerly called vRealize Log Insight.

entries.name: VMware Aria Suite
entries.definition: A bundle of VMware cloud management products for automation, operations, logging and cost management, formerly called vRealize Suite.

entries.name: Vocational rehabilitation counseling
entries.definition: Counseling people with disabilities or injuries to help them choose, prepare for, find and keep suitable work.

entries.name: Voice UI design
entries.definition: Designing interfaces that people use by speaking, such as voice assistants and phone menus.

entries.name: VPython
entries.definition: A Python module for creating simple 3D visualisations and animations, widely used for teaching physics.

entries.name: Vue.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript framework for building user interfaces and single-page web applications.

entries.name: Vulkan
entries.definition: A low-overhead, cross-platform graphics and compute API from the Khronos Group.

entries.name: Vulnerability assessment
entries.definition: Finding, classifying and ranking security weaknesses in systems, networks or applications so they can be fixed.

entries.name: Vyond
entries.definition: A cloud-based tool for making animated videos from templates and characters, called GoAnimate before 2018.

entries.name: Wage and hour laws
entries.definition: The laws that set minimum wages, overtime pay, working hours and related record-keeping rules for employees.

entries.name: Wainscot panelling
entries.definition: Fitting decorative panels, usually of wood, to the lower part of interior walls.

entries.name: Warehouse automation
entries.definition: Using machinery and software, such as conveyors, robots and automated storage systems, to move and store goods in a warehouse with less manual handling.

entries.name: WASAPI
entries.definition: The Windows Audio Session API, a Microsoft Windows interface that lets applications play and record audio streams.

entries.name: Waste characterisation
entries.definition: Determining the physical, chemical and sometimes radiological properties of waste so that it can be classified, handled and disposed of correctly.

entries.name: Waste minimisation
entries.definition: Reducing the amount of waste a process or organization produces, preferably at the source.

entries.name: Watchkeeping
entries.definition: Standing a watch aboard a ship, monitoring navigation, machinery and safety while on duty.

entries.name: watchOS
entries.definition: Apple's operating system for the Apple Watch.

entries.name: Watcom SQL
entries.definition: A relational database management system from Watcom that was later developed as Sybase SQL Anywhere.

entries.name: Water-based pipe coating
entries.definition: Applying water-based (waterborne) coatings to pipes as a protective layer.

entries.name: Water quality modelling
entries.definition: Using mathematical models to simulate and predict the quality of water in rivers, lakes, reservoirs or supply networks.

entries.name: Wave phase
entries.definition: For a repeating wave, how far through its cycle it is at a given moment, usually expressed as an angle.

entries.name: Waveguide
entries.definition: A structure, such as a hollow metal pipe or an optical fibre, that guides electromagnetic or light waves along a path.

entries.name: Web crawling
entries.definition: Building or running programs that automatically follow links and fetch web pages, for example to index sites or collect data.

entries.name: Web development
entries.definition: Building software delivered through web technologies.

entries.name: Web filtering
entries.definition: Blocking or allowing access to websites according to rules such as category, reputation or policy.

entries.name: WebCT
entries.definition: A commercial learning management system for running online courses, later acquired by Blackboard.

entries.name: WebCTRL
entries.definition: A web-based building automation system from Automated Logic for monitoring and controlling building equipment such as heating and cooling.

entries.name: WebDriver
entries.definition: A W3C standard interface for controlling a web browser from a program, which Selenium's WebDriver implements.

entries.name: WebDriverJS
entries.definition: The JavaScript bindings for Selenium WebDriver, used to automate web browsers from Node.js.

entries.name: Website optimization
entries.definition: Improving a website's speed, search visibility, usability or conversion rate.

entries.name: Website wireframing
entries.definition: Sketching the basic layout and structure of web pages, without final visual design, before they are built.
